title: Zay Flowers: John Harbaugh made Ravens practice too hard, Jesse Minter won't

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Zay Flowers: John Harbaugh made Ravens practice too hard, Jesse Minter won't
sources.description: "That’s why we had a lot of injuries. Because of how we practiced, how we went. The load was heavy," Flowers said of Harbaugh's practices.
